                                                     1 Introduction
                                                         Antimicrobial resistance (AMR) is one of the most pressing challenges facing global
                                                     health, threatening the efficacy of existing antibiotics and jeopardizing decades of progress in
                                                     infectious disease management (Salam et al., 2023). The rise of multidrug-resistant (MDR)
                                                     pathogens, including methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA), extended-spectrum
                                                     beta-lactamase (ESBL)-producing Escherichia coli, carbapenem-resistant Klebsiella
                                                     pneumoniae, and multidrug-resistant Pseudomonas aeruginosa, has significantly limited
                                                     therapeutic options, resulting in increased morbidity, mortality, and healthcare costs (van
